Safety valves function is to protect boiler from over pressure.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Bakr, reviewed 
by eng Omar Hamed Ibrahem, tested by eng. Al Sayed Abd El Rehim Mohamed, accepted by general director eng. 
Farag Hamza Farag, approved by eng Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar; head sector 
of Kafr El-Dawar Steam Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance stuff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.

Safety 
 and healthy equipment must be used 
 (safety helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).

Ear plugs and eye protection should 
 be used when working on a valve which is under pressure.

Never strike a valve 
 which is under pressure. Premature actuation can result.

Never stand in front of the discharge outlet of a pressure relief valve, 
 which is under pressure.
Always approach and use any pressure relief valve with great care.
Lapping grey cast iron emery paper.
Check the O-ring sealing and replace it if necessary.
Check for external and internal leakage
Check the tightening of the piston.

Inspect the seat for damage, use for guiding a fixture with emery paper; 
 figure 3-a or fixture that is mounted on drilling machine with emery paper 
 P.V. see figure 3-b, if the repair of valve body is not possible, contact 
 the manufacturer.

Inspect the core and repair it on Lathe or replace it if repair is not 
 possible.

Clean and test the function of all parts of 
 control instrument, if required replace membrane valve, or replace of other 
 damaged parts / air hoses, manometers, reducing valve, ... etc.

Check the air distribution between control 
 instruments and safety valve from leakage and repair.

Replace the tubes of air by stainless steal tube 
 if required, if needed the valve of the air inlet system should be repaired / 
 replace of sealing O-ring on cone / grinding of seat surface ... etc, and the 
 cone should be tightened to the spindle.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Safety valves function is to protect boiler from over pressure.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Bakr, reviewed 
by eng Omar Hamed Ibrahem, tested by eng. Al Sayed Abd El Rehim Mohamed, accepted by general director eng. 
Farag Hamza Farag, approved by eng Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar; head sector 
of Kafr El-Dawar Steam Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance stuff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Safety 
 and healthy equipment must be used 
 (safety helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).
Ear plugs and eye protection should 
 be used when working on a valve which is under pressure.
Never strike a valve 
 which is under pressure. Premature actuation can result.
Never stand in front of the discharge outlet of a pressure relief valve, 
 which is under pressure.
Always approach and use any pressure relief valve with great care.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Suitable lifting device
Lapping grey cast iron emery paper.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the O-ring sealing and replace it if necessary.
Check for external and internal leakage
Check the tightening of the piston.
Inspect the seat for damage, use for guiding a fixture with emery paper; 
 figure 3-a or fixture that is mounted on drilling machine with emery paper 
 P.V. see figure 3-b, if the repair of valve body is not possible, contact 
 the manufacturer.
Inspect the core and repair it on Lathe or replace it if repair is not 
 possible.
Clean and test the function of all parts of 
 control instrument, if required replace membrane valve, or replace of other 
 damaged parts / air hoses, manometers, reducing valve, ... etc.
Check the air distribution between control 
 instruments and safety valve from leakage and repair.
Replace the tubes of air by stainless steal tube 
 if required, if needed the valve of the air inlet system should be repaired / 
 replace of sealing O-ring on cone / grinding of seat surface ... etc, and the 
 cone should be tightened to the spindle.
